text: Risk management is the process of identifying possible problems before they happen. First, you need to find the risks that could affect your project or business. Once you know them, you can create mitigation strategies to reduce their impact. For example, you might buy insurance or train your staff better. It is also wise to have contingency plans, which are backup plans in case something goes wrong. Finally, you should keep monitoring the situation regularly, because new risks can appear at any time. Good risk management helps you stay calm and make better decisions when problems arise.
